Frequently asked questions

Here's everything you need to know to get started, manage your account, and make the most of Quikit AI.

What is Quikit AI?−
Quikit AI is an all-in-one business operating system that brings CRM, HR, marketing, operations, and AI agents into a single unified platform.
Can I start for free?+
Yes. Our Starter plan is completely free with up to 5 users and 2 apps. No credit card required. You can upgrade at any time as your business grows.
How does the AI work across apps?+
Quikit AI is built into the core of every app — not bolted on. It learns from your data and surfaces recommendations, automates tasks, and predicts outcomes across CRM, HR, and operations.
Can I switch plans at any time?+
Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately. Downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle. No penalties for switching.
Is my data secure?+
Yes. We are SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and we never sell or share it with third parties.
Do you offer enterprise plans?+
Yes. Our Enterprise plan includes dedicated infrastructure, custom SLAs, SSO/SAML, white-glove onboarding, and a dedicated Customer Success Manager.
Can I integrate with existing tools?+
Absolutely. Quikit connects with 100+ tools including Slack, Google Workspace, Zapier, Stripe, and more via native connectors and REST API.
How do I get support?+
You can reach our support team via live chat, email at support@quikit.ai, or through the contact page. Growth and Enterprise users get priority response within 4 hours.
